name: Kouyoku Senki ExS-Tia TS Parallel Episode 3 - Twilight Sabre
original_name: 光翼戦姫エクスティアTS パラレルエピソード3 トワイライトセイバー
source:
When ExS-TIAs was in the verge of defeated by Naiolo, Shihou Souma activate ExS-TIA System and defeat Naiolo. However, due to the system feedback, Souma's body become a woman. And now, while Marina and the others can't fight, Souma has to fight the remaining monsters left in their place.

This will become an alternate story of the second half ExS-Tia 3. After everyone's defeat, what if Souma turn into woman and fight... That kind of situation now can be enjoyed.

[Translated from [url=http://lusterise.nexton-net.jp/product/exs-tia_para/ep03/]official site[/url]]
translation:
就在众光翼战姬即将败在奈奥罗手下的千钧一发之际，紫峰创真强行启动ExS-TIA系统一举击败了奈奥罗。然而受到系统反噬的影响，创真的肉体竟变成了女性！如今，在真理奈等人无力再战的情况下，创真不得不代替她们迎击残余的魔物大军。

本作是基于《光翼战姬ExS-TIA 3》后半段剧情展开的平行世界IF线故事。“假如在众人战败之后，由创真女体化变身出战的话……”——如今你便能亲自体验这一充满魅力的全新展开。

[译自[url=http://lusterise.nexton-net.jp/product/exs-tia_para/ep03/]官方网站[/url]]
